newsitem.title: USA: Excite to revamp Internet Web site content.
newsitem.headline: Excite to revamp Internet Web site content.

text.p: Excite Inc on Wednesday unveiled a three-part plan to shift the direction of its Internet Web site content, towards a format more familiar to consumers and advertisers.
The first phase of the shift will be implemented over the next 45 days, moving Excite.com from a product-based model to a channels model, with no visual changes, the company said.
The company will initially roll out 14 channels in coming weeks, beginning with channel topics such as Arts and Entertainment, Sports, Business, Computing and the Internet.

Excite said the channels model allows the firm to simplify the consumer experience by leveraging navigational habits learned from television, partner with content providers and allow advertisers to buy in a more familar way.
Phase two will begin in April when Excite.com changes visually and all Excite content is offered to consumers through channels, the company said.
In the final phase, set for the third or fourth quarters, of this year, Excite will set out each channel on the site as an independent unit, ultimately managed by its own producer.
